newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Huaqiang to list 18 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China Huaqiang to list 18 mln A shares.

text.p: Shenzhen Huaqiang Industry Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would list 18 million A shares and two million staff shares on the Shenzhen bourse on January 30.
The A shares were offered at 11.40 yuan each in Shenzhen earlier this month and were 94.04 times oversubscribed, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Staff shares were placed in 1993, the firm said without giving the price.

Huaqiang said in a prospectus it expected to rack up 196.74 million yuan in net proceeds from the offer and funnel most of the money into its core business of colour television and other audio-visual equipment production.
The company said it forecast net profits of 69.82 million yuan for 1997, compared with 68.82 million yuan estimated for last year and 70.67 million yuan posted for 1995.
After the listing, Huaqiang will have a total of 80 million shares, composed of 42 million state shares, 20 million A shares and 18 million internal staff shares.
